say:1:1310140001:1.text: Hello! You're a merchant from the Mithril Consortium, right? We have a question for you.
say:1:1310140001:1.source_cn: 你好，你是秘银商会的商人吧？请问……

say:2:1310140002:1.text: *Muttering* Ah, right, this is supposed to be delivered to the Moonlit Enclave... Huh? Oh, is there something you need?
say:2:1310140002:1.source_cn: 嗯，没错，这批货应该是送到月影邻地的……呃？你们有什么...

say:4:1310140003:1.text: Are there any carriages heading to Cedartown? It's gotta be a carriage, by the way. NO ships!
say:4:1310140003:1.source_cn: 圣石镇有通往雪松镇的驿车吗？注意，一定要是车，不能是船！

say:5:1310140004:1.text: Cedartown... Oh, in the Duchy of Whiteridge! Setting out now means you're off to the Snowspire Festival, right?
say:5:1310140004:1.source_cn: 雪松镇……唔，白山公国啊！这时节出发，是要去参加冬日祭...

say:6:1310140005:1.text: You wish to travel by land? That's definitely an option. In fact, it's actually faster to travel by land than by sea.
say:6:1310140005:1.source_cn: 你们打算走陆路？也不是不行。其实单论距离，走陆路去雪松...

say:7:1310140006:1.text: However, with all the snow, the roads can be dangerous and slippery. The carriage can only take you to the outskirts of Whiteridge, you'll have to walk the rest of the way to Cedartown yourself.
say:7:1310140006:1.source_cn: 不过这个季节白山一定会下雪。积雪湿滑，山路曲折危险，驿...

say:8:1310140007:1.text: No worries about walking! Getting to Whiteridge is what matters.
say:8:1310140007:1.source_cn: 嚯，走路无所谓，只要能到白山，什么都好说！

say:9:1310140008:1.text: Gotcha. I'll go arrange a carriage for you. Don't worry, I'll make sure you get there before the festival begins!
say:9:1310140008:1.source_cn: 既然这样，那我就去安排驿车了。放心，一定在祭典开幕前把...

say:10:1310140009:1.text: Come find me when you're ready.
say:10:1310140009:1.source_cn: 你们准备好了就来找我吧。
